packageRules.description: Opt out of routine version bumps for everything; the group below re-enables the trio. Vulnerability fixes are exempt via the vulnerabilityAlerts block, which sets force.enabled=true.

npm: one grouped PR weekly. Must NOT carry matchUpdateTypes - rules apply at pre-lookup, before updateType is known, so a conditional rule never clears the wildcard disable above. Must stay BEFORE the vite-plus rule: packageRules is last-match-wins, so an npm group placed after it absorbs the trio and destroys its lockstep grouping.
npm majors and the framer-motion -> motion rename stay parked; they surface on the Dependency Dashboard. Narrows the npm rule above; must stay after it.

npm semver sorts the prerelease tag 6.0.4-alpha9 AFTER 6.0.4-alpha24 as a string, so Renovate offers alpha24 -> alpha9 as a patch. That is a 501-day downgrade; a rollback guard does not catch it because the updateType is patch.
